package_name: Chamba & Sach Pass (6D) — The Most Dangerous Road

itinerary.day_1: Pathankot → Dalhousie (Drive: 80 km · 2.5 hrs). Places: Dalhousie, Khajjiar. Activities: Khajjiar meadow stop; Dalhousie colonial walk; Dainkund Peak sunset.
itinerary.day_2: Dalhousie → Chamba (Drive: 50 km · 1.5 hrs). Places: Chamba Town. Activities: Bhuri Singh Museum; Chamba Rumal embroidery workshop; Lakshmi Narayan Temple.
itinerary.day_3: Chamba → Bharmour (Drive: 65 km · 2.5 hrs). Places: Bharmour, Manimahesh Lake. Activities: 84-temple complex; Manimahesh Lake short trek; Alpine meadow photography.
itinerary.day_4: Bharmour → Sach Pass (Drive: 90 km · 4 hrs). Places: Sach Pass, Pangi Valley. Activities: Sach Pass (4,420m) crossing; Snowfields and switchbacks; Killar valley panorama.
itinerary.day_5: Pangi Valley (Drive: Local 30 km). Places: Pangi Valley. Activities: Remote tribal villages; Chenab river gorge views; Killar fort ruins.
itinerary.day_6: Return to Pathankot (Drive: 260 km · 7 hrs). Activities: Early mountain departure; Chamba brief stop; Pathankot arrival.
